name: Bounded queue under overload: M/M/2/50 drops what it cannot hold
description: Offered load is 5/s against 2 servers at 0.5 s each (capacity 4/s), so the system is permanently overloaded. The queue holds at most 50 entities and drops the rest (queue.NumberDropped); latency is bounded by the buffer (about 50 / 4 = 12.5 s) instead of growing without limit. Compare with an unbounded queue by deleting maxLength.
